t: The Spear and Jackson Razorsharp Advance bypass wishbone hedge shears are robust manual garden tools designed for efficient hedge trimming and garden maintenance. Featuring durable chrome-plated C50 carbon steel blades, these shears offer rust and scratch resistance, with notched sections to cut thicker stems cleanly. Ideal for professional landscapers and gardeners, the ergonomic wishbone-shaped handles provide a comfortable soft-grip, reducing user fatigue during extended use. Integrated shock absorbers enhance comfort, while adjustable tensioning allows for precise cutting control. These 570mm hedge shears ensure reliable performance for various landscaping tasks.
